_comment: Adopter overlay-exemption config (see docs/adopter-guide.md). List your OWN private-overlay directory NAME(s) in extra_exempt_dirs to keep that top-level directory out of the three value-flagging gates (the PII, secrets, and placeholder scanners) without editing tool source. Each entry is a bare directory name matched TOP-LEVEL-ANCHORED and DIRECTORY-ONLY: it exempts only a directory of that name directly under the repository root, never a nested directory, and never a file of that name. A shipped corpus/tooling directory name (or an absolute/multi-segment/empty value) is rejected and skipped with a warning, so the config can NEVER blind a gate over shipped library content. IMPORTANT: only those three value gates honor this exemption; OTHER corpus-integrity gates with their own file discovery may still scan your overlay AND echo lines from it in their output, so keep genuinely sensitive values (credentials) out of the committed fork entirely rather than relying on this exemption alone. The shipped library carries an empty list.
